title: Portainer 2.39.0 before 2.39.9, 2.40.0 before 2.45.4, and 3.0.0 before 3.1.0 contains an authorization bypass…
description: Portainer versions 2.39.0 before 2.39.9, 2.40.0 before 2.45.4, and 3.0.0 before 3.1.0 have an authorization bypass vulnerability. This flaw allows Standard users to access containers belonging to other users via WebSocket attach and exec endpoints. Attackers with access to a shared environment can hijack sessions by using leaked container or exec IDs, potentially gaining interactive root shell access.
